subtopics.title: SFT vs Pre-training Objectives
subtopics.summary: Explains how SFT shifts a model from generic text completion to conversational instruction-following using labeled instruction-response pairs.

subtopics.title: Next-Token vs Infilling Finetuning
subtopics.summary: Describes the two SFT approaches: predicting the next token versus filling in blanks, with infilling being useful for text editing and code debugging.

subtopics.title: Finetuning Frameworks and Compute
subtopics.summary: Covers popular SFT frameworks such as LLaMA-Factory, PEFT, and Axolotl, and the compute requirements for full versus adapter-based finetuning.
